integrity_statement: Proof is self-contained for the stated class and exact universal quantifiers. Reproducible finite-dimensional matrix checks supplement, but do not substitute for, the proof. No independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional Hilbert--Schmidt mixing only; not trace, diamond, entropy, or thermodynamic cost.
Unitary must be complex Hadamard and have monomial square; not a theorem for arbitrary coined graph walks.
The complete two-mutually-unbiased-measurement erasure principle is acknowledged as established prior knowledge.
Publication-priority uncertainty remains for specialized variable-strength Fourier dephasing products.
title: Exact singular spectrum and optimal two-parity dephasing budget for Fourier-type quantum channels
